title: P6-A managed IMAGEDEF native-witness packet preparation
scope: Prepare a bounded, from-scratch AutoCAD managed-API witness packet for the open IMAGEDEF create/remove/erase/clone/WBLOCK operation gate.

primaryApiSources.title: Autodesk Attach and Scale a Raster Image (.NET)
primaryApiSources.observation: The documented managed workflow creates the image dictionary, sets a RasterImageDef entry, adds a RasterImage, enables raster reactors, and associates the definition.

primaryApiSources.title: Autodesk RasterImage class (.NET)
primaryApiSources.observation: RasterImage and RasterImageDef are separate objects; an image uses one definition, and a RasterImageDefReactor is linked to both graph endpoints.

primaryApiSources.title: Autodesk RasterImageDefReactor (ObjectARX)
primaryApiSources.observation: The reactor is attached to the definition's persistent reactor list and owned by the image entity; erasing a definition triggers dependent image erasure.

primaryApiSources.title: Autodesk DBObject.GetPersistentReactorIds (.NET)
primaryApiSources.observation: The API exposes the persistent reactor collection for readback.

primaryApiSources.title: Autodesk RasterImageDef properties (.NET)
primaryApiSources.observation: The managed properties expose both the source file path and the active file path used by the image definition.

primaryApiSources.title: Autodesk DBDictionary.Remove(ObjectId) (.NET)
primaryApiSources.observation: The dictionary entry can be removed by the stored object ID; native effects are captured by the host operation and reopen reports.

primaryApiSources.title: Autodesk Database.SaveAs(string, DwgVersion) (.NET)
primaryApiSources.observation: The database can be written to a new, explicit path and drawing version for isolated operation derivatives.

packet.baseline: Creates a scratch-only 2x2 BMP from bytes authored in the managed command, registers one IMAGEDEF in ISM_RASTER_IMAGE_DICT, associates one RasterImage, and saves a new current-version DWG and receipt.
packet.observer: After close/reopen, reports DWG and resolved external BMP hashes, AutoCAD/assembly versions, DBMOD, NOD dictionary identity, IMAGEDEF owner/source/reactors, image owner/definition/reactor, and persistent-reactor membership. Requires DBMOD=0.
isolatedOperations: RasterImageDef.Erase(true) into a separate new derivative, with dependent image/reactor erased-state capture both before and after transaction completion
AutoCAD COPY on a separate baseline copy
AutoCAD WBLOCK on a separate baseline copy
packet.outputHandling: All created BMP, DWG, and report files are exclusive-create outputs intended to remain in a remote scratch directory outside the repository. The baseline is never overwritten.

validation.sdkBuild: NOT_RUN: AutoCAD release, Windows host profile, and matching managed assemblies are not yet supplied.
validation.nativeCapture: NOT_RUN: the remote host product/build and artifact-return route remain unidentified.

limitations: The checked project targets AutoCAD 2024 on Windows; another release requires a host-specific assembly review before build/run.
COPY and WBLOCK are operator-run in separate baseline copies; the returned reports are the evidence of their resulting native graph.
A passing native graph report does not prove DWG physical field spans, libdxfrw output, strict ASCII/Binary support, independent-consumer behavior, or broader profile support.
next: Record the remote host profile and return route once. Build only against the matching AutoCAD SDK, create and reopen the baseline, capture each isolated remove/erase/copy/WBLOCK derivative, then join exact hashes and native graph observations to strict libdxfrw output, failure/retry, and fresh independent readback.
